note: A second, ILLUSTRATIVE organism profile demonstrating that swapping organisms means shipping a profile, not editing the engine (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). It covers exactly three well-established genes from the primary literature (see catalogue.json's provenance notes) and is not a clinically validated M. abscessus resistance panel. whiB7 is a known upstream regulator of erm(41)/aminoglycoside-response genes (Hurst-Hess et al. 2017) but is deliberately NOT modelled here: unlike Rv0678 in the bundled MTB profile, loss of function in whiB7 plausibly DECREASES resistance (it is a positive regulator of the inducible-resistance response), which is the opposite direction from the efflux_regulatory lane's loss-of-function-implies-resistance assumption. Encoding it there would misrepresent the biology, so it is omitted rather than force-fit.
locus_length_note: length_bp is null throughout, exactly as in the bundled MTB profile: no reference annotation is fabricated, and callable-fraction evidence must come from the input mask.
